title: GAIKA: catalog archive walk skips non-directory entries
goal: tests/project-doc-counts.test.mjs walks var/catalog and opens <entry>/products.ndjson for every entry not ending in .json. Live var/catalog also holds plain files such as refresh-queue.json.post-reconcile-20261117T152856Z (and its .keys), left by the archive migration. Opening <file>/products.ndjson throws ENOTDIR, which is not caught (only ENOENT is), so the ROADMAP cross-cutting blockers test fails wherever the archives exist. Make every var/catalog walk in this test file count only directories, and add a regression test that proves a non-directory entry is skipped without needing the real 2 GB archives. Work from the live code 1181e47d. No deploy, no change to var/, no network.
acceptance_criteria: Every var/catalog walk in tests/project-doc-counts.test.mjs ignores non-directory entries (by file type, not by name pattern)

A regression test builds a temporary catalog with one shop directory holding products.ndjson and plain files named like refresh-queue.json.post-reconcile-<stamp> and .keys, and fails on the old logic with ENOTDIR
No assertion is weakened or removed; skips without archives stay as they are
Only test files change; no product code, var/ or docs change
